name_reason: Follows data_fd2_<domain>_<descriptor> convention: domain=dialog, descriptor encodes the table semantics (shop inventory-full reject dialog), the data type (_table), and that it holds FDTXT text ids (_text_id_). No Ghidra address residue in the name. Consistent with the 7 sibling per-tier dialog tables in dlgtab.c that all share the _dialog_text_id_table suffix. The _dialog token appearing twice is the established sibling-family naming pattern, not redundant noise.
purpose: Per-shop-tier FDTXT dialog page text-id for the "inventory is full" reject message shown in the chapter-intro shop menu when a recipient already has 8/8 inventory slots filled.
logic_summary: int16[6] const lookup table indexed by data_fd2_chapter_intro_menu_cursor_state @ 0x5412B (the shop-tier radio state, 0..5). The selected int16 element is passed straight as the FDTXT page id to fd2_display_dialog_scene. Read in-place by two callers (buy flow and give/trade flow), unlike the sibling tables which the buy menu block-copies onto the stack. Content {1, 506, 1, 506, 506, 506}.
element_semantics: Each element is an FDTXT.DAT dialog page text-id (signed 16-bit), selected by shop-tier radio state index 0..5. Values: [0]=1, [1]=506, [2]=1, [3]=506, [4]=506, [5]=506.
